name: @openclaw/tokenomics
description: Tokenomics: host-neutral, local-first LLM spend accounting. Append-only spend ledger, public price-list catalog (OpenRouter/LiteLLM), period + by-model rollups, and a free-vs-paid usage report with an avoided-spend counterfactual. A thin per-host ingestion seam plugs into pi, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenClaw; the core has no coding-tool dependency.
